SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-30-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-31-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF BRIAN TOLLE IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. PLAINTIFF ERIC BARBUS IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT GUADALUPE HERNANDEZ IS NOT PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY RICADO HERNANDEZ (BROTHER OF PLAINTIFF AND SOLE OWNER OF PROPERTY) IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS ALICIA PACINI (MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT OF RICADO HERNANDEZ). COURT DISMISSED GUADALUPE HERNANDEZ AS NAMED DEFENDANT AND TO ADD RICADO HERNANDEZ AS DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF ORALLY DECLARATION CHANGE OF ADDRESS TO "2115 N. SAINT LOUIS AVE. APT#1, CHICAGO, IL 60647". PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1,232.50 (COSTS IS WAIVED) TO THE PLAINTIFF. PAYMENT TO BE MADE BY CHECK AND MAILED OUT TO PLAINTIFF'S UPDATED ADDRESS. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE OCTOBER 31, 2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: SYLVIA L. HUSING; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
